rationale: Preparing the aftermath probe exposed a false premise inside my own observed-behavior knowledge entry rather than in the target: a native run of the extended harness shows the candidate's log still ending at (index=10, term=1) when it becomes leader, i.e. the term-2 entry appended by leader 1 was never replicated to the followers in this harness, so it was neither committed by leader 1 nor part of the new leader's prefix. I correct that entry's statement and conditions under its existing id, note the affected interpretation in affected_uses, and keep the receipt-backed core of the observation (acceptance of the peer-form MsgForgetLeader and the resulting quorum-scale election) untouched because it does not depend on that premise. The extended aftermath harness is written and runs, but its commit-progress measurement came out inconsistent with my expectation (new leader's commit stayed at 10 after the incumbent's append response), so it is not filed as an experiment this turn; that measurement needs inspection first.

knowledge.statement: In a three-voter group, one peer-form MsgForgetLeader delivered to the single other voter (node 2) is enough for a candidate whose log equals that voter's log to win the pre-vote, win the real vote and become StateLeader at term 3 while the incumbent node 1 still reports StateLeader at term 2; the incumbent answered neither the pre-vote nor the vote request (its own lease suppressed both), and once the leader's next real heartbeat was processed the follower's context was restored and the identical pre-vote was ignored again.
knowledge.conditions: Observation indices 5-8 and 13-18 of CheckRun 4ff9bf25cb164dd8bcf9d3be02aa1568; config ElectionTick=10, HeartbeatTick=1, CheckQuorum+PreVote, voters {1,2,3} with a shared log at index=10/term=1 in the storage snapshot. Correction of an earlier premise: the term-2 entry appended by leader 1 was not replicated to the followers by this harness (a later native run of the extended harness shows the new leader appending with prev=(index=10, term=1)), so that entry was uncommitted and no part of any comparison here depends on it; the incumbent was not fed the new leader's messages, so its demotion path is outside this observation; no follower was ticked, so follower election timeouts did not fire.
knowledge.changed_premise: The earlier revision claimed the incumbent's term-2 entry was replicated and committed and that the new leader's prefix contained it; the harness never delivered that append, so both claims are withdrawn while the cited observations (acceptance at index 13, granted pre-vote at 14, granted vote at 15, candidate StateLeader at 17, incumbent still StateLeader at 18, restore at 7/8) are unchanged.
